ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface with a macro-level ratio of approximately 85:15 white to black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity field across both central lobes. High-contrast low-intensity (black) clusters are localized at the distal tips: the left tip displays a complex mottled blob, while the right tip features distinct elongated linear groupings. A narrow, continuous low-intensity band follows the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular macro-serrations detected along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a series of 8-12 distinct sawtooth-like peaks with pixel amplitudes of 5-10 units; left lobe edge shows similar frequency but is partially occluded by spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly concave sweep trajectory from the notch to the distal tips; right lobe tip shows a significant jagged termination indicating non-uniform curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of small (approx. 4-6 pixel diameter) low-intensity circular clusters in the mid-lower section of the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Group of 4-5 parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake-like) on the distal right lobe tip; secondary complex of unaligned linear disruptions on the far left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss and jagged contour deformation at the far-right distal tip; distinct parallel rake marks on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'claw-shaped' pigmentation pattern on the right tip consisting of three long, parallel dark strokes ending in a concentrated pixel cluster.
